name: How often should a bathroom be repainted?

mainEntity.name: How often should a bathroom be repainted?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of repainting a bathroom depends on factors such as humidity levels, ventilation, paint quality, and usage. Generally, a bathroom should be repainted every 3 to 5 years to maintain its appearance and protect against moisture damage. High-traffic bathrooms, or those with poor ventilation, may require more frequent repainting. Signs like peeling paint, mildew growth, or faded color indicate it's time for a fresh coat. Regular cleaning and good ventilation can extend the life of your bathroom paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathrooms should typically be repainted every 3 to 5 years, depending on humidity, ventilation, and paint quality.
